classes.name: GoA Business Analyst
concerns: Rapid problem articulation without requiring prior ADSP technical knowledge
Non-technical plain language solution recommendations and reasoning
Persistent sessions to support multi-day planning engagements across browser restarts

classes.name: GoA Developer
concerns: ADSP service integration guidance and access to specialist agents for technical depth
Implementation planning for service composition based on accepted hypotheses
Technical implementation detail from specialist agents on individual ADSP services

classes.name: ADSP Platform Team
concerns: Platform standards compliance including initializePlatform, Keycloak, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ patterns
Multi-tenant data isolation and operational reliability of the planner-service
Security audit trail and monitoring for all tenant operations

classes.name: ADSP Tenant Administrator
concerns: Tenant-scoped configuration of business pattern libraries via the administrative interface
User access management and RBAC role assignments for planner-service
Custom pattern creation and maintenance for department-specific business processes

classes.name: GoA Program Manager
concerns: Solution plan visibility and progress tracking across planning engagements
Cost and effort estimation for proposed ADSP service compositions
Approval of solution hypotheses before implementation investment is committed
